title: Existence of a gate CNF
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $p$ be a tuple of an input-head position and work-head positions, let $q$ be a case consisting of an optional state, an optional input symbol, and one optional symbol per work tape, and let $b$ be a codec bit. There exists a CNF formula whose cost is at most $2^{3k+7}(3k+8)$ and which, under every Boolean assignment to its variables, evaluates to the gate value obtained by wiring those variables to the prescribed ports.
